## Biography
Er. Himanshu Dwivedi is an Indian computer science engineering student and full-stack software developer from Gonda, Uttar Pradesh. He is known for creating the HDTalk real-time communication platform, founding the PrepWithHD student academic portal, and building high-performance web systems with PHP, MySQL, and WebSockets.
